question: Is terminal production-hook proof plus focused regression coverage sufficient to merge this compaction fallback filter without a live two-agent timing capture?
rationale: The patch is narrow and well-covered at the source boundary, but it touches session-state and message-delivery replay safety where maintainers may require live timing proof before landing.

options.title: Accept Scoped Proof
options.body: Land the PR with the current terminal proof because it exercises the production compaction hook and regression-tests both replay removal and safe-text preservation.

options.title: Require Live Two-Agent Proof
options.body: Ask for a real two-agent compaction recovery run showing one delivered reply and preserved safe source context before merge.

options.title: Reconsider Boundary
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want replay safety handled through a broader side-effect, transcript, or API boundary instead of local fallback filtering.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Proof
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the current terminal proof because it exercises the production compaction hook and regression-tests both replay removal and safe-text preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across compaction, agent runtime, and inter-session provenance in the affected paths.
